findings:
F1 (non-blocking, process documentation gap tied to claim 3): the report's § Sweeps table does not show a distinct case-insensitive `-s/-ed/-ing` inflection pass per renamed symbol, as the brief's Method step 2 and AGENTS.md's failing-first/sweep discipline describe. Independent verification (this audit's own greps) confirms no stale form of any renamed or removed symbol (`type` discriminant literals, `expectLockstep`/`expectJSONRoundtrip`, `U2`, `npm.cmd`/`mkdtempSync`/`rmSync`, `AGENTS §`/`§N`) survives in `src`, `tests`, `guides/contract.md`, `guides/README.md`, or `README.md`, so the underlying requirement (old name gone) is met; only the documentation of the sweep methodology falls short of the letter of the Method step. Prescription for the next unit that touches this package: when recording a rename sweep, name both the word-boundary pattern and a second case-insensitive pass covering `-s`, `-ed`, `-ing` inflections explicitly in the commit/report, even where the symbol is a compound identifier unlikely to inflect, so the record itself — not just the outcome — satisfies the rule.
